integrity: The complete derivation and a standalone integer-arithmetic verifier are supplied. Computational checks supplement the proof and do not certify infinitely many cases. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary words of length at least six, with overlaps of lengths one, two or three forbidden; no statement about all-length overlaps, noisy channels, or larger alphabets. The leading boundary template can tie at phase transition densities.
title: Exact fixed-weight capacities for binary short-overlap synchronization codes
